About the Position

The MRC North West programme supports doctoral research in medical sciences. Applicants compete for funded research training through the participating programme rather than applying for a general unrestricted cash award.

Research Areas

  • Medical science
  • Biomedical research
  • Research training

Funding and Duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryUKRI-rate stipend; exact amount not stated
DurationFour years

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityProgramme and project criteria apply; see official eligibility guidance
Further conditionsTuition and four-year stipend; check project and nationality conditions.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusUpcoming: opens 26 October 2026
Deadline / consideration round27 November 2026
LocationUnited Kingdom

About University of Manchester

Manchester hosts doctoral programmes in medicine, bioscience and other research fields. Its Faculty of Biology, Medicine and Health coordinates funded training routes, including MRC programmes and cancer research studentships.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Follow the official application instructions

2026/27 UKRI reference rate: the minimum UKRI doctoral stipend is £21,805 per year, tax-free (London institutions +£2,000), effective 1 October 2026.

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://www.bmh.manchester.ac.uk/study/research/funding-fees/funded-programmes/mrc-nwdp/

Source: bmh.manchester.ac.uk - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 27 November 2026 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 27 November 2026. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.

Open the official application page ↗
